info.description: platformd's API, as the web app, the MCP server and the Python package (`storscale`) use it. Sign in with a Keycloak token of the realm `lakehouse` as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (a person's, or a service account's), or with the web app's session, whose changes also send `X-Platform-Request: 1`. Every call runs as whoever signed in, under their projects' rules; a refusal says why, with a request ID.
info.title: StorScale Platform API
